sentences.text:
This is the third application filed by the applicant u/S. 483 of B.N.S.S. for grant of bail relating to Crime No.265/24 registered at Police Station - Sabalgarh, District - Morena(M.P.) for the offence under Sections 376, 450, 506 of IPC.
2.
As per the prosecution's story, father of the prosecutrix has lodged the FIR against the present applicant.
Thereafter, during investigation statements of the prosecutrix and other relatives were taken by the police and case has been registered under the aforesaid crime at P.S. Sabalgarh, District Morena.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant / accused argued that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated.
He is in custody since 17.06.2024.
His first bail application was dismissed on merit vide order dated 13.11.2024 passed in M.Cr.C.No.37828/2024.

His second bail application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 18.02.2025 passed in M.Cr.C No.3813/2025 with a direction to the learned trial court to conclude the trial as expeditiously as possible.

After the dismissal of the aforesaid bail applications, charge-sheet has been filed and the NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-GWL:16715 2 MCRC-27064-2025 prosecutrix has no objection to the bail application filed by the present applicant as she has filed an affidavit in this regard.
Conclusion of the trial is likely to take long time to conclude.

Applicant is the permanent resident of District - Morena (M.P.)
and there is no possibility of his absconsion or tampering with the prosecution evidence, if released on bail.
Hence, prayed for grant of bail to the applicant.

4. On the other hand, learned State counsel vehemently opposed the bail application and prayed for Chitra Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/163335150/
1 its rejection.
5.

sentences.text: Counsel for the complainant has no objection to the bail application filed by the applicant.

6. Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary.
7.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) along with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/Committal Court.
Learned State counsel is directed to send an e-copy of this order to the Station House Officer of the concerned Police Station for information and necessary action.
9. E- copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance, if possible, by the office of this Court.
10. Certified copy as per rules.
